title: a16z Podcast: The IQ and EQ of Robots

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: with Boris Sofman (@bsofman), Dave Touretzky (@DaveTouretzky).
reader_summary.overview: with Boris Sofman (@bsofman), Dave Touretzky (@DaveTouretzky), and Hanne Tidnam (@omnivorousread) We're just now beginning to truly see the the first 'real' robots in the home. How are humans beginning to forge relationships with these robotic devices (/entities!) -- and how will those relationships develop? What do we learn as we begin to forge relationships and interact with robotic toys like Cosmo and Vector -- about robots, and about ourselves?

key_points.text: And what do these learnings teach us about the possibility of adding a "personality wrapper" to new technologies?
